description: This file defines the internal class ClientGrainContext in the Orleans project, which implements multiple interfaces for managing grain context, extensions, components, and lifecycle within the Orleans runtime. It handles extension registration, component retrieval, and provides access to grain-specific data and services.

classes.name: ClientGrainContext
classes.description: Implementation of IGrainContext and related interfaces for client-side grain context management, including component, extension handling, and lifecycle methods.

methods.name: GetComponent
methods.description: Retrieves a registered component of type TComponent, either from cache, from services, or default.

methods.name: SetComponent
methods.description: Sets or removes a component of type TComponent in the context.

methods.name: GetOrSetExtension
methods.description: Retrieves an existing extension or creates and registers a new one using the provided factory function.

methods.name: GetExtension
methods.description: Retrieves a registered extension of specified interface type.
